description: Maps numeric rank points to the displayed rank class/grade and point band, with a loss floor.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_RankPoint. Rows are enumerated by GameRankPoint_FindRow and sorted by threshold Min for previous/next navigation, where Row->Id identifies the current tier; the result-change widget also compares CurrentRank->Id with PreviousRank->Id to decide up/down/no-change.

RankPointClass.simple: Rank class (tier group) shown in UI and used for matchmaking borders.
RankPointClass.technical: EGameRankPointClass, default None. UGamePlayerRankWidget::SetRankPoint and grade-info UI pass it to SetRank to choose the rank icon and spacer visibility; the result-change widget maps it to a localized rank label; online session helpers switch on it to compute rank borders. KPI telemetry records the numeric class.

RankPointGrade.simple: Rank grade (subdivision) shown in rank UI.
RankPointGrade.technical: EGameRankPointGrade, default None. Passed alongside RankPointClass to UGamePlayerRankWidget::SetRank and grade-info UI, where RankGrade->SetGrade(Grade) displays it. The rank-system manual also sorts class rows by RankPointGrade.

Id_GlobalThreshold.simple: Point band that defines this rank tier.
Id_GlobalThreshold.technical: FName, default None. GameRankPoint_FindRow walks RankPointDataTables (DTM+0x380), resolves each Id_GlobalThreshold in GlobalThresholdDataTables and returns the row whose inclusive [Min, Max] contains the queried rank point; when no band matches it returns the first row as a fallback. UI widgets sort rows by the threshold Min and use neighbouring rows' Min values for progress bars; leaderboard card packing/recovering uses the row index to reconstruct a rank point from the threshold Min.

LoseLowerLimit.simple: Minimum rank-point delta after a loss.
LoseLowerLimit.technical: int32, default 0. CalcRankPointDelta looks up the current RankPoint row for a losing player and applies FMath::Max(Points, LoseLowerLimit); a further clamp to >= 0 applies when an AI-controlled ally flag is present. Exported rows use 0, -5, -10, -20 and lower for higher tiers.

notes: The exported asset has 27 rows with FGameDataTableRow_RankPoint; the manager loads RankPointDataTable into RankPointDataTables (DTM+0x380). No localization variants or numbered shards were supplied.

GameRankPoint_FindRow is used widely: gameplay loss clamping, lobby/player-card/online UI, session matchmaking borders, shop gating and KPI telemetry. The same row can therefore affect both presentation and match rules.
The first-row fallback when no threshold matches is explicit in the reconstructed finder; consumers such as UGamePlayerRankWidget::SetRankPoint dereference the result without a null test.
Finder 0x13077a0 and navigation helper 0x1626350 are reconstructed; status/functions.json should be consulted for byte status. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspected.

usages.detail: GameRankPoint_FindRow maps a numeric rank point to a tier via Id_GlobalThreshold.
CalcRankPointDelta clamps a loss to the row's LoseLowerLimit.
Displays the rank class/grade and threshold progress using neighbouring rows.
Result UI maps class to text and detects rank changes by row Id.
Online session filtering computes matchmaking borders from RankPointClass.
Leaderboard card packing uses row order and threshold Min to encode/decode rank.
